title: Affine pro-etale subsite computes the small pro-etale topos
statement:
Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and compatible universes and skeletons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $X_{\mathrm{aff,proet}}$ be the full subsite whose objects are affine weakly etale maps $U\to X$, with standard pro-etale coverings (finite families of affine weakly etale maps satisfying the covering condition of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]). Restriction along the inclusion induces an equivalence of topoi
$$\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}})\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{aff,proet}}).$$
